headline: Unanimous Buy, still below its highs
chart_note: 52-week range: $255.97 - $461.62. Currently $392.61, about 15% below its high after a volatile year.
why_today: UnitedHealth has recovered well off its 52-week low but still trades about 15% below its high. Every analyst covering the stock rates it a Buy - a rare unanimous consensus for a name that had a rough stretch earlier in the year.
pro_1: All 23 covering analysts rate it Buy - unusually unanimous - with an average target of $475 implying roughly 21% upside
pro_2: Reasonable PE of 24.4x for the largest health insurer, still well off its 52-week high
con_1: The stock's wide 52-week range ($256-$462) reflects real volatility and past investor concern this year
con_2: Healthcare payers remain exposed to regulatory and reimbursement policy risk that can move the stock sharply
